verdict.rationale: The GitHub README describes an autonomous agent that searches, navigates, and retrieves data without URLs (firecrawl-gh-1), and states that you can "set how much reasoning the agent spends on the task" (firecrawl-gh-2). That directly matches the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the low/medium/high levels, in-depth first-party docs on the parameter and its cost or limit effects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
